description: A muted charcoal-grey knee-length wool tunic with narrow rust-brown woven trim at the neckline, wrists and lower hem, over an ivory linen long-sleeved underlayer. A sturdy dark-brown leather belt with plain buckle, dusty-brown wool trousers, dark burgundy-brown lower-leg wraps and simple brown leather shoes. Clean practical early medieval Scandinavian landowner clothing with restrained good workmanship; no headgear, armor, weapons, fur war gear or heraldic devices.
